total_supply_at_constructor.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set by the HypoVault constructor

underlying_assets_at_constructor.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault at construction

total_assets_before_first_fulfillment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() == assetsDeposited) observed before the first fulfilment

supply_zero_at_start.meaning: the vault starts with zero share supply

assets_exist_at_mint.meaning: underlying assets exist when shares are minted

first_depositor_share_control.meaning: first depositor instantly controls ~100% of shares for negligible cost

assumptions: The constructor pre-set totalSupply of 1 000 000 shares is the supply observable at the constructor checkpoint.
totalAssets == 1 is the observable before the first fulfilment.

unresolved.description: The intent 'start with zero supply and mint shares only when assets exist' is a qualitative bootstrap requirement; the report gives no numeric share-mint formula or proportionality relation linking supply, assets and minted shares, so no cross-multiplied value relation can be grounded.
The impact's '~100% of shares for negligible cost' has no numeric share quantity, cost amount, or total-supply denominator stated, so the share-control magnitude cannot be encoded beyond a Boolean.

limitations: The safety relation is encoded as a qualitative Boolean obligation because the report supplies no numeric share-mint formula.
The impact outcome is a Boolean witness because the report gives no concrete share count or cost amount.
The constructor's zero underlying assets fact is not separately encoded as a numeric predicate; only the totalSupply literal is bound.
